philosophy.vibe_quote: Code like a turtle, vibe like a ninja.

bio.name: Aditya Vahlevy Nugraha
bio.degree_detail: Computer Science graduate from Universitas Pertamina (Cum Laude, GPA 3.58)
bio.current_role_detail: Software Engineer at PT Pupuk Indonesia (Persero)
paragraphs: I learn how a business process really works, then turn it into software people use every day. Sometimes that is a simple web app. Sometimes it is a map or an AI agent. At Pupuk Indonesia I build three internal platforms. PINTER lets business teams build their own AI assistants without code, with a smart router that sends each message to a model that fits it. AeGIS Atlas is a fertilizer demand planning map across 34 provinces, where numbers update as planners change their assumptions. NEXUS moves carrier contracts and freight tariffs for 122 warehouses out of spreadsheets.

I work closely with the people who use what I build, from workshops and user testing to the final release. On the technical side I work across the stack: FastAPI and Go services on PostgreSQL and Neo4j, React 19 frontends, and the tests that keep the business logic honest. Before this I predicted rice yield from Sentinel-2 imagery with LightGBM and Optuna, and digitized a rejection tracking workflow at Astra Otoparts.
Beyond the screen, I'm an APERTI BUMN Scholarship awardee, a former Vice President of my student association, and someone who probably thinks about system design way too much at 2am.

thanks.intro: I owe a lot to the people who showed me how. Most of what I know about building software for real users, I learned from them.
